assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW landscape 3:2 cinematic game concept painting for In to the Crackrooms, using the supplied existing concept images as visual/world references, not as layouts to copy. Reference 1 establishes the reflective spherical egg, vast yellow fluorescent Backrooms chamber, chasm, scaffolding, and yellow-suited researchers. Reference 2 establishes decaying architecture, material detail and moody light. Preserve this visual family: painterly realistic materials, immense scale, mundane industrial equipment, warm stale fluorescents and deep atmospheric shadows. No logos, no title typography, no watermarks. This is exploratory art for a development guide, not a finished game screenshot. Scene: the beginning of a workday. Wide establishing view from the arrival landing in the open chamber. A small practical go-kart carrying two yellow-suited researchers has just emerged from a square maze passage. On the same safe landing, clearly stage an automated resource deposit conveyor/hopper and a separate modest equipment counter with wall racks holding a hammer, auger and scaffold parts. The huge reflective glass sphere and precarious scaffold access loom beyond a guarded edge over the chasm. Readable spatial relationship between kart arrival, deposit, shop and egg; the starting facilities are already installed, no construction of a new camp. Ordinary company worksite, quiet anticipation, no readable signs necessary.
